about: SW-6129 per-crate RoPE / adaLN-modulate route table, enforced by scripts/check_candle_rope_modulate_routes.py (a pure source scan; the candle twin of mlx-gen's SW-6140 table). Shared RoPE: candle_gen::rope::{apply_rope, apply_rope_in_place, rms_norm_rope(_in_place), apply_rope_freqs_cis} over a RopeSpec (pairing interleaved|split-half, layout BSHD|BHSD, partial rotary, f32|native math) - the fused strided media_rope kernel on CUDA, bit-identical to the shared reference chain that runs everywhere else (SW-6128) - and candle_gen::apply_interleaved_rope (= apply_rope with INTERLEAVED_BHSD_F32 since SW-6129; within one product rounding of the candle rope_i it replaced on CUDA, bit-identical on CPU). Shared modulate: candle_gen::modulate::{modulate, modulate_with} (composable normed*(1+scale)+shift / normed*scale+shift, the exact body of every former private copy) and the fused AdaLN: candle_gen::modulate::{adaln, rms_adaln, layer_adaln, adaln_scale_only} bit-identical to candle's ops::rms_norm / ops::layer_norm + modulate (SW-6127), and candle_gen::modulate::{adaln_chain, adaln_chain_scale_only} bit-identical to the composable mean/sub/sqr/mean/+eps/sqrt/div LayerNorm and RMS chains in f32 or native bf16 (SW-6129). 'shared fused' = the site runs one of those kernels on CUDA. 'exact' = bit-identical to the former private op chain on every backend; 'scale-only' = a norm*(1+scale) factor with no shift, which is not the modulate affine.
